text:
alice.mgmt: Heads-up: shrinkwrap packaging for private-vpc RC coming up during tomorrow's 02:00-03:00 UTC window. Need final checksum + cosign before handoff.
ben.build: copying artifacts to offsite mirror now. tgz + manifest generated. checksum: sha256:3f1a9c... 
ben.build: I've added a shrinkwrap file at /artifacts/rc-2026-03-22/shrinkwrap.json and updated packaging tag to rc-2026-03-22-1 
carol.release: can we pin images to the immutable tag instead of floating 'latest'? prefer full digest in manifest.
ben.build: yes, using digests. example: gcr.io/rw-inference/installer@sha256:abcd1234 
deploy-bot: deploy request queued by carol.release for channel=private-vpc, artifact=rc-2026-03-22-1, canary=3, rollout=linear(25%, 5m)
dave-ops: quick checklist: cosign signed? KMS key in staging rotated? network egress rule for mirror validated?
eve-sec: cosign signed with key id rw-cosign-prod-1. I rotated staging KMS yesterday and validated access. ACLs look good.
ben.build: sending tarball to escort. transport checksum posted to /handshake/checksums.txt and to ops-sig channel.
carol.release: canary window: start 02:05 UTC, 3 seeds in staging vpc, metrics to watch: p95 latency, 5xx ratio, error-rate, startup time.
dave-ops: rollback criteria proposed: if 5xx_ratio > 0.5% over 2m OR p95 increased by >30% relative to baseline OR canary pods fail readiness >1/3 within 10m -> auto-abort + roll back to previous manifest.
alice.mgmt: also include disk IO errors and cosign verification failures as hard aborts. If cosign fails at any node -> immediate stop.
ben.build: deploy-bot will run post-deploy verifications: cosign-verify, sha256 compare, k8s image pull, readiness probes. snippet: `deploy-bot verify --manifest rc-2026-03-22-1 --checks cosign,sha256,pull`
deploy-bot: preflight OK: cosign verified on 3/3 nodes, sha256 matched, image pulls succeeded in canary cluster.
carol.release: note: shrinkwrap delta includes a small rpm bump for the operator. Ops, watch migration job for 00:30s extra runtime.
dave-ops: acknowledged. I'll keep an eye on job-run durations and filesystem mounts.
eve-sec: reminder: sign-off checklist requires: cosign sig, manifest digest, attestations present. I have attestation uploaded.
alice.mgmt: final question: if we need to hot-rollback, are we okay with pinning back to previous digest or do we need a rebuild?
ben.build: we can pin back to previous digest; images are immutable. rollback will be: update manifest to previous digest and re-apply.
carol.release: good. I'll kick the deploy at 02:00 UTC. tagging release notes now and posting to customer-success after canary pass.
deploy-bot: rollout started at 02:00:35 UTC, canary seeds: pod-rca1, pod-rca2, pod-rca3.
dave-ops: seeing initial spike in startup memory on pod-rca2, but readiness passed after 8s. monitoring.
alice.mgmt: if readiness >30s across seeds, cancel.
carol.release: deploy-bot please emit an explicit event when canary crosses 10m mark.
deploy-bot: canary 10m reached. metrics summary: p95 +12%, 5xx 0.12%, readiness avg 9s. No abort triggered.
carol.release: rolling to 25% now.
dave-ops: watchlist: mirror IO, sig verification logs, ingress 502s. ping me if any 502s spike.
alice.mgmt: thanks team. Postmortem note: track shrinkwrap-to-release latency and any last-minute checksum mismatches.
ben.build: moving artifacts to sealed bucket for on-prem handoff. signing the final manifest and writing delivery note.
eve-sec: copied signing key ARN to the handoff doc and recorded KMS audit id.
carol.release: closing thread — will create release notes and escalation doc if rollback needed. :ship:
